player_prompt.intro:
Ami Player {player_id} achi. Ami Battleship khelatachi.
Ami amar birodhira sab jahaja dubaite chai, jodi na tara amar jahaja dubai.
Amar palatare, ami nirdishto aksharankera upar missile fire korte pari '[a4]' ei formatete. Jodi missile ta jahajare lage, tahake 'X' diye chinha kora hoi. Jodi na lage, tahake 'O' diye chinha kora hoi. Dui khetre, khelar paribesh amake janabe amar hits. Jodi ami ekta jahaja dubai, khelar paribesh amake janabe!
Khela ses hoi jokhon ek player amar jahaja dubai.
Amar ager board amar sab jahaja rakha thakbe, amar birodhira hits amar upar, amar hits ar miss amar birodhira board upar, kintu amar birodhira jahaja dekhaibe na.
Ei amar ager board:
